description: This file defines a custom exception class Zend_XmlRpc_Client_FaultException that extends another exception class, Zend_XmlRpc_Client_Exception. It represents an exception thrown when an XML-RPC fault response is encountered in the Zend Framework's XML-RPC client component.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Client_FaultException
classes.description: A specialized exception class used to signal an XML-RPC fault response in the Zend Framework's XML-RPC client component.
